verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a CLI with first-party support for headless use. The docs cover `NONINTERACTIVE=1` installs, unattended `.pkg` installs, `--yes` flags in administrative scripts and scheduled jobs (including when no user is logged in), and the scriptable `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` pattern. They also say one command can set up dependencies in CI services such as GitHub Actions. One community comment calls Homebrew brittle on CI, but it gives no concrete failure, so it lowers confidence slightly rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of reliable CI runs.
